The '''M2398 system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] which was also known as the '''Blood Nest system''', due to the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang known to inhabit the region. Located in the [[Halori sector/Legends|Halori sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="EAOC" /> it contained the uninhabited [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]], [[M2398]], surrounded by an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] and at least one [[Moon/Legends|moon]].

==History==
A band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] used the moon, known as the [[Blood Nest]], and asteroid belt as a headquarters. [[Wraith Squadron]] went to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to carry out the missions of the [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']], a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] which was captured by the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] from [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]].

The first Wraith to die, [[Jesmin Ackbar]], was killed in a [[Battle of M2398-3|dogfight]] over the moon.
